record_reviews.summary: Darwin reviews failed hybridization of peas, beans, sweet peas and Lupinus, explaining early anther opening and possible repeated pollen application. He then describes paper pollen caps, reports four successful Sweet Pea pods and a possible Lathyrus hybrid, and proposes the caps as a general method. It is an experimental publication, not a reply to another packet source.
